summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing that its 2026 OG Investor Session will premiere on September 30, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. ET via X, with simulcasts on LinkedIn and YouTube. The session features presentations from CEO James Yamanaka, CFO Greg Guyatt, and Finn Age Hänsel, plus a fireside Q&A; no transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine investor-communications event rather than a special situation; watch only for any subsequent strategic or capital-allocation announcements disclosed during the session.
